tasks.design: Configure native source indexing in {DOCS} and actual numerical-data import in the scientific analysis platform {OTHER}. The engineer chooses methods, conducts the study, interprets uncertainty and checks the final study record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Studies can repeat source navigation and exact numerical data transfer.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and verified input mappings can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Environmental relevance, study validity and nuclear consequences require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises limits in observations and avoids treating a model result as established environmental effect.
tasks.altitude: Less study preparation and data copying; scientific judgement remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scientific source indexing and numerical imports can reduce navigation and copying; they do not establish environmental validity or a local savings baseline.

assumptions: Actual source owners supply dataset identity, location/time coverage, values, units and quality. Engineer verifies relevance in s1 and captures actual study observations in s3; missing values and unsupported observations stay manual in s4.
Cuts cover source navigation and exact copying, not reading scientific meaning, fieldwork, method choice or interpretation. Native imports first; already automated transfers earn zero saving.
Studies can be field or desk based. Shares are a provisional mix, not a mandatory field campaign per study or a measured baseline; reweight actual branches and retain primary evidence work.

Existing study notes are fully retained. Routine save is one percent and uses the existing final record check. External publication or submission is a separate actual gated action with no saving claimed.
unknowns: Which actual numerical data is still copied?
How much source preparation is navigation?
research_questions: Can native import reduce copying after complete source and unit checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual environmental source links and data mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s6 checked final environmental study record and exact study destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 source navigation + 15*0.40 numerical copying = 16; minus 1.5 upkeep = 14.5. Half eligible gives 8 minus 1.5 = 6.5. Study methods, actual observations, interpretation, record and save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure native source links in {DOCS}, reusable setup components and case input tables in the scientific modelling platform {OTHER}. The engineer chooses formulations and test cases, verifies setup and results and directs the actual research.
tasks.previous_blocker: Model research can repeat version lookup, component setup and chosen case entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable components and case tables can reduce repeated configuration.
tasks.still_hard: Formulation validity, scientific interpretation and new model uses require expert judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer detects results that are numerically plausible but theoretically wrong.
tasks.altitude: Less research-model setup; scientific direction stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scientific modelling platforms can reuse components and predefined case inputs; they do not choose valid nuclear theory or establish new scientific findings.

assumptions: Actual prior model owner supplies versioned components and documented interfaces. Engineer verifies sources in s1 and supplies exact formulation, equations, input values/units, cases and acceptance criteria in s2; missing or unsupported components remain manual in s3/s4.

S3 cuts repeated setup, not new scientific formulation or substantive code development. S4 cuts repeated chosen case entry/output collection, not solver runtime or model acceptance. Actual result verification and interpretation remain in retained s4/s5.
Design and direction are alternative or combined branches. Shares are provisional, not measured baselines; reweight actual research paths. Existing reusable setup earns zero new saving.

No plant control or operational deployment is introduced. Actual publication, project assignment or implementation is a separate gated action outside this research boundary. Save retains one percent and uses the existing final record check.
unknowns: Which setup components are actually repeated?
How much case entry is still manual?
research_questions: Can native component/case reuse reduce setup after full scientific verification?

approvals.approved_version: s6 checked final research-model record and exact research destination; edits require recheck

tasks.short: Keep current through technical reading and independent study.

steps.what: Find actual technical journals and nuclear developments relevant to current research
inputs: actual journal and technical source records

steps.what: Read technical journals and conduct independent study and research on nuclear developments
outputs: actual understanding of nuclear developments and limitations

tasks.design: Configure native topic/source filters in the research library in {DOCS}. The engineer checks relevance and reads original technical work, retaining independent reasoning and study.
tasks.previous_blocker: Keeping current can repeat navigation across relevant technical sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source filters can reduce repeated discovery navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding assumptions, evidence and implications requires actual reading and research.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes a relevant scientific development from a superficially similar claim.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; learning stays fully retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-library filters can support discovery; summaries do not replace technical reading and independent study.

assumptions: Actual journal/source metadata already exists; engineer supplies actual topics and checks source relevance in s1. Missing source access and scientific interpretation remain human work.

Boundary is discovery, reading and independent study. No separate record write, report or send is required by the stated task; any actual additional scholarly output is decomposed separately rather than invented as administration.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Only repeated navigation is eligible; existing filters earn no saving. No automated scientific understanding is assumed.
unknowns: Are native topic filters already used?
research_questions: Can native filters shorten discovery without reducing original-source reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Reading and independent scientific study remain fully retained.
